EMPHASIS.Settings.abilityChecks.Name: Allow Emphasis: Ability Checks
EMPHASIS.Settings.abilityChecks.Hint: Adds the Emphasis option to generic ability check dialogs.
EMPHASIS.Settings.skillChecks.Name: Allow Emphasis: Skill Checks
EMPHASIS.Settings.skillChecks.Hint: Adds the Emphasis option to skill check dialogs.
EMPHASIS.Settings.toolChecks.Name: Allow Emphasis: Tool Checks
EMPHASIS.Settings.toolChecks.Hint: Adds the Emphasis option to tool check dialogs.
EMPHASIS.Settings.savingThrows.Name: Allow Emphasis: Saving Throws
EMPHASIS.Settings.savingThrows.Hint: Adds the Emphasis option to saving throw dialogs. Death saving throws are controlled separately.
EMPHASIS.Settings.deathSavingThrows.Name: Allow Emphasis: Death Saving Throws
EMPHASIS.Settings.deathSavingThrows.Hint: Adds the Emphasis option to death saving throw dialogs. Disabled by default because the source rule does not normally include death saves.
EMPHASIS.Settings.attackRolls.Name: Allow Emphasis: Attack Rolls
EMPHASIS.Settings.attackRolls.Hint: Adds the Emphasis option to attack roll dialogs.
EMPHASIS.Settings.showDiceTray.Name: Show Emphasis in Dice Tray
EMPHASIS.Settings.showDiceTray.Hint: Shows a two-d20 Emphasis button in Dice Tray. Clicking it rolls immediately and applies the tray's numeric modifier.
EMPHASIS.Settings.tiebreaker.Name: Emphasis Tie Resolution
EMPHASIS.Settings.tiebreaker.Hint: Determines what happens when both d20 results are equally distant from 10, such as 7 and 13.
